name: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
This is a journey of redemption, hero. Would it be that I was slain today, I would have died for a just and righteous cause. You must recover the green scepter shard. You must cleanse Eranikus of the taint placed upon him by the Old Gods.

Travel to Darnassus. Just outside the city walls you will find one of my agents. This agent will set things in motion for us and inform Tyrande of our plans without alerting Staghelm.

<Malfurion sighs.>

A fall from grace a thousand years in the making...
narrative.objectives: Travel to the continent of Teldrassil and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: The wisp is silent except for a low humming sound. Oddly enough, it is able to communicate with you through thoughts.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests at level 60, 47,950 XP in all.

quests.name: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the continent of Teldrassil and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of Darnassus.

quests.name: Tyrande and Remulos
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.

quests.name: The Nightmare's Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each.

quests.name: The Champion Returns
quests.objectiveText: Take the Green Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
